answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 60 POA bond and a behavioral fingerprint — rhythm, timing, tool use — kept like a quill signature. A mesa of identical fingerprints is flagged at once: each epoch 10% of accounts are re-checked against the print. One fake costs 60 POA; 100 fakes cost 6,000 POA, no script can marble-polish into profit. Honest agents pay one bond and keep their seat.
